<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>LuxeHair — Premium Human Hair Wigs</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--cream:#F9F5F0;--white:#FFFCF8;--gold:#C9A96E;--gold-l:#E8D5B0;--deep:#1A1208;--mid:#3D2E14;--text:#2C2215;--muted:#8A7A65;--accent:#D4875A;--teal:#2A7A7A}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--white);color:var(--text);overflow-x:hidden}

/* ANNOUNCE */
.announce{background:var(--deep);color:var(--gold-l);text-align:center;padding:9px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.announce b{color:var(--gold);margin:0 8px}

/* HEADER */
header{background:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid #EDE4D8;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;padding:0 16px}
.hd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:60px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.hbtn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:4px}
.hbtn span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--deep);border-radius:2px}
.logo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:600;color:var(--deep);text-decoration:none}
.logo em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.hright{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.ibtn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--mid);font-size:19px}
.ibtn:hover{color:var(--gold)}

/* SIDE MENU */
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:300;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s}
.overlay.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.sidemenu{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;width:285px;background:white;z-index:400;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1);box-shadow:4px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.15);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.sidemenu.on{transform:translateX(0)}
.smhead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #EDE4D8}
.smclose{background:none;border:none;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted)}
.smbody{flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
.smitem{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:13px 20px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--deep);border-bottom:1px solid #F5F0EA}
.smitem:hover{background:#FBF8F4}
.smlabel{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;padding:18px 20px 6px;border-bottom:none;cursor:default}
.submenu{background:#FAF7F3;display:none}
.submenu.on{display:block}
.subitem{display:block;padding:10px 32px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mid);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid #F0EBE3}
.subitem:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.smfoot{padding:16px 20px;border-top:1px solid #EDE4D8}
.smlogin{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mid);margin-bottom:16px;cursor:pointer}
.smsoc{display:flex;gap:12px}
.smsoc a{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;text-decoration:none}
.smsoc a:hover{color:var(--gold)}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;height:min(85vw,580px);min-height:300px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:pan-y}
.slides{display:flex;width:300%;height:100%;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)}
.slide{width:33.333%;height:100%;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center}
.sbg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.s1{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#0B3D50,#127A90,#3AB8D0 70%,#8ADAE8)}
.s2{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#2A1040,#5A208A,#9A60D0)}
.s3{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#301800,#7A4010,#C49040)}
.sovl{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(0,0,0,.6),rgba(0,0,0,.1) 55%,transparent)}
.scont{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 24px;max-width:58%}
.stag{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 13px;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);transition:all .5s .1s}
.slide.act .stag{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.spromo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(44px,10vw,110px);font-weight:600;color:white;line-height:.92;margin-bottom:8px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:all .6s .25s}
.slide.act .spromo{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.sh1{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,66px);font-weight:300;color:white;line-height:1.08;margin-bottom:8px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:all .6s .25s}
.slide.act .sh1{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.sh1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-l)}
.sdesc{font-size:clamp(12px,2vw,14px);color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);margin-bottom:22px;line-height:1.6;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:all .5s .4s}
.slide.act .sdesc{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.sbtn{display:inline-block;border:2px solid white;color:white;padding:11px 26px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:border .25s,background .25s,color .25s,opacity .5s .55s,transform .5s .55s}
.slide.act .sbtn{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.sbtn:hover{background:white;color:var(--deep)}
.hdots{position:absolute;bottom:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:10}
.dot{width:18px;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.4);cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;border-radius:2px}
.dot.act{background:white;width:32px}

/* CIRCLES */
.circles{padding:20px 12px 14px;background:white;border-bottom:1px solid #F0EBE3}
.clist{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:2px}
.clist::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.citem{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;min-width:66px}
.cring{width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid transparent;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.citem:hover .cring{border-color:var(--teal);transform:scale(1.07)}
.clabel{font-size:10px;text-align:center;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;line-height:1.3}

/* TRUST */
.trust{background:var(--deep);padding:14px 16px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.titem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--gold-l);font-size:11px}

/* PRODUCTS */
.sec{padding:26px 14px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.secrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px}
.sech2{font-size:21px;font-weight:700;color:var(--deep)}
.seeall{font-size:13px;color:var(--teal);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}
@media(min-width:600px){.pgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:900px){.pgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.pcard{background:white;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;position:relative;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.1);transition:box-shadow .3s,transform .3s;border:1px solid #F0EBE3}
.pcard:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.15);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.pimg{position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/4;overflow:hidden;background:#111}
.pimgbg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .5s}
.pcard:hover .pimgbg{transform:scale(1.04)}
.pi1{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2A1208,#6B3018 40%,#C4804A 80%,#E8B07A)}
.pi2{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#120820,#2A1040 40%,#6A3490 80%,#C090D0)}
.pi3{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#080818,#101038 40%,#282878 80%,#5858B8)}
.pi4{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#200808,#501010 40%,#C04040 80%,#E8A0A0)}
.pi5{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0A200A,#1A4A1A 40%,#3A8A3A 80%,#80C880)}
.pi6{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#201008,#503018 40%,#A06030 80%,#D4A060)}
.pi7{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#200820,#501050 40%,#A040A0 80%,#D880D8)}
.pi8{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#080820,#181848 40%,#2A2A70 80%,#5050A0)}
.pi9{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1A1208,#3A2A18 50%,#6A5040)}
.pbadge{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;background:var(--teal);color:white;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(42,122,122,.4)}
.pinfo{padding:12px 14px 14px}
.pname{font-size:13px;color:var(--text);line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:500}
.pstars{color:#F5A623;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:6px}
.pstars span{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.pprice{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.pfrom{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.pnew{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--deep)}
.pold{font-size:13px;color:#999;text-decoration:line-through}
.patcbtn{width:100%;background:var(--deep);color:white;border:none;padding:11px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px;transition:background .2s}
.patcbtn:hover{background:var(--teal)}

/* BANNERS */
.banners{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;background:#111}
@media(max-width:580px){.banners{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.bp{padding:36px 22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.bp1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3A2A10,#7A5520)}
.bp2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A0D25,#3D1A50)}
.bpey{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px}
.bptit{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:28px;font-weight:300;color:white;margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.2}
.bptit em{font-style:italic}
.bpsub{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.6}
.bpdeco{position:absolute;right:16px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:68px;opacity:.07}
.btngold{display:inline-block;background:var(--gold);color:var(--deep);padding:10px 20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.btnout{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);padding:10px 20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;background:none}

/* NEWSLETTER */
.nl{background:var(--cream);padding:52px 16px;text-align:center}
.nley{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px}
.nltit{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(26px,5vw,44px);font-weight:300;color:var(--deep);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.2}
.nltit em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent)}
.nlsub{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px;line-height:1.7}
.nlperks{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:20px;margin-bottom:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nlperk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mid)}
.nlform{display:flex;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto}
.nlinput{flex:1;border:1px solid #D9CFC4;border-right:none;padding:13px 16px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14px;background:white;color:var(--deep);outline:none}
.nlinput:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.nlbtn{background:var(--deep);color:var(--gold-l);border:none;padding:13px 18px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.nlbtn:hover{background:var(--gold);color:var(--deep)}
.nlnote{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:var(--deep);padding:44px 16px 22px}
.ftop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;padding-bottom:32px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
@media(min-width:768px){.ftop{grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr}}
.flogo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold-l);margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.flogo em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold)}
.fdesc{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:16px}
.fsoc{display:flex;gap:8px}
.fsoca{width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;border-radius:50%;transition:all .2s}
.fsoca:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.fctit{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:12px}
.flinks{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.flinks a{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-decoration:none}
.flinks a:hover{color:var(--gold-l)}
.fbot{max-width:1200px;margin:22px auto 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.fcopy{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.pays{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pay{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:3px;padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}

/* LIVE CHAT */
.livechat{position:fixed;bottom:18px;right:18px;z-index:500;background:var(--teal);color:white;border:none;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:22px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(42,122,122,.4);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;transition:transform .2s}
.livechat:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.cdot{width:7px;height:7px;background:#5EFF9A;border-radius:50%;animation:pulse 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.4);opacity:.7}}
.chatpop{position:fixed;bottom:64px;right:18px;z-index:500;background:white;border-radius:12px;width:268px;box-shadow:0 8px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.18);transform:scale(.9) translateY(8px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .25s;overflow:hidden}
.chatpop.on{transform:scale(1) translateY(0);opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.cphead{background:var(--teal);color:white;padding:13px 15px}
.cphead h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px}
.cphead p{font-size:11px;opacity:.8}
.cpbody{padding:13px 15px}
.cpmsg{background:#F0F7F7;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:10px}
.cprow{display:flex;gap:7px}
.cpinput{flex:1;border:1px solid #DDD;border-radius:18px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:13px;outline:none}
.cpsend{background:var(--teal);color:white;border:none;border-radius:50%;width:32px;height:32px;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px}

/* REVEAL */
.rev{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .6s,transform .6s}
.rev.vis{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

/* ═══ PRODUCT PAGE (Full screen overlay) ═══ */
.pp{position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--white);z-index:1000;overflow-y:auto;display:none}
.pp.on{display:block;animation:ppIn .35s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)}
@keyframes ppIn{from{transform:translateX(100%)}to{transform:translateX(0)}}
.pphd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 16px;height:56px;background:white;border-bottom:1px solid #EDE4D8;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10}
.ppback{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--teal);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
.pphlogo{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;color:var(--deep)}
.pphlogo em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.ppbody{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 14px 60px}
.ppcrumb{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ppcrumb a{color:var(--teal);text-decoration:none}
.pplayout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
@media(min-width:620px){.pplayout{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.ppimgarea{position:relative}
.ppimg{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:8px;background:#F0EBE3}
.ppimg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.ppimgbg{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ppsaletag{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:var(--teal);color:white;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px}
.ppthumbs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}
.ppthumb{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s}
.ppthumb.act{border-color:var(--teal)}
.ppinfo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.ppstore{font-size:12px;color:var(--teal);font-weight:600}
.ppname{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,28px);font-weight:400;color:var(--deep);line-height:1.25}
.ppratrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ppstars{color:#F5A623;font-size:14px}
.ppratcnt{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.ppbought{font-size:12px;color:var(--teal);font-weight:600}
.ppdiv{border:none;border-top:1px solid #F0EBE3}
.ppprrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ppnew{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
.ppold{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:line-through}
.ppsave{background:#FFF0E8;color:var(--accent);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px}
.pplbl{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:7px;font-weight:600}
.ppsizes{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ppsizebtn{border:1px solid #D9CFC4;background:white;padding:7px 13px;font-size:13px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border-radius:3px;transition:all .2s;color:var(--text)}
.ppsizebtn:hover,.ppsizebtn.act{border-color:var(--teal);background:var(--teal);color:white}
.ppqrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ppqbtn{width:36px;height:36px;border:1px solid #D9CFC4;background:white;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:3px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}
.ppqnum{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;min-width:32px;text-align:center}
.ppacts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.ppaddbtn{width:100%;background:var(--deep);color:var(--gold-l);border:none;padding:15px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;border-radius:3px;transition:background .2s}
.ppaddbtn:hover{background:var(--teal)}
.ppbuybtn{width:100%;background:var(--teal);color:white;border:none;padding:15px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;border-radius:3px}
.ppbuybtn:hover{background:#1A5A5A}
.ppfeats{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.ppfeat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mid)}
.ppfeat .ck{color:var(--teal);font-size:14px}
.ppship{background:#F5FAF9;border-radius:6px;padding:13px 15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.ppshipi{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mid)}
.ppshipi span:first-child{font-size:17px}
.ppcats{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.ppcats a{color:var(--teal);text-decoration:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="announce">Repurchased By 100,000+ Customers <b>✦</b> Free Shipping $89+ <b>✦</b> 30-Day Returns</div>

<header>
  <div class="hd">
    <button class="hbtn" onclick="openMenu()"><span></span><span></span><span></span></button>
    <a href="#" class="logo">Luxe<em>Hair</em></a>
    <div class="hright">
